description: A bank can build small and large branches to serve their customers. A small branch can serve 50 customers per day and requires 10 bank tellers. A large branch can serve 100 customers per day and requires 15 bank tellers. The bank has available 200 bank tellers and needs to be able to serve at least 1200 customers per day. How many of each branch size should they build to minimize the total number of branches needed?

CustomersSmall.definition: Number of customers a small branch can serve per day

TellersSmall.definition: Number of tellers required by a small branch

CustomersLarge.definition: Number of customers a large branch can serve per day

TellersLarge.definition: Number of tellers required by a large branch

TotalTellers.definition: Total number of available bank tellers

MinCustomers.definition: Minimum number of customers that need to be served per day

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of branches (small and large) that the bank builds"

constraints.description: 10 times the number of small branches plus 15 times the number of large branches should not exceed 200 (total available tellers)
50 times the number of small branches plus 100 times the number of large branches should be at least 1200 (minimum customers served per day)
The numbers of small and large branches built should be non-negative

SmallBranches.definition: Number of small branches to build

LargeBranches.definition: Number of large branches to build
